fact: At a ministerial council on 13 February 2026 the communications minister listed projects completed by end 2025, including the unified portal for administrative services, remote payment of the road tax and the electronic tax stamp.
title: تقدّم إنجاز مشاريع التحوّل الرّقمي للإدارة محور مجلس وزاري بإشراف رئيسة الحكومة
